name: ludo-platform
description: Production-grade multiplayer Ludo built as microservices

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ludo/shared && npm run build --workspace @ludo/kit && npm run build --workspace @ludo/engine && npm run build --workspace @ludo/events && npm run build --workspace @ludo/identity --workspace @ludo/room --workspace @ludo/game --workspace @ludo/gateway --workspace @ludo/bff
scripts.db:init: docker compose exec -T postgres psql -U ludo -d ludo < db/init.sql
